note: Newest first. To add an update: put a new object at the top of "releases" (id = the date, e.g. 2026-11-04). Tags: New, Improved, Changed, Fixed. Keep each item to one plain sentence.

releases.title: Make it yours: themes, backgrounds and discussions

items.text: Question discussions: signed-in users can comment under every practice question, with a display name (never your email), reporting and community guidelines.
68 color themes, each with a light and a dark version, including 46 PowerShell ISE palettes. The light/dark button always switches within the theme you picked.
An Appearance page (the palette button beside light/dark) with a compact theme list, filters and a live preview.

Ten animated backgrounds that follow your theme: Galaxy, Neon grid, Circuit board, Code rain, Constellation network, Aurora, Network globe, Wireframe terrain, Data tunnel and Fiber streaks. Or turn them off.
Skills & Topics: three non-certification learning paths (CLI and scripting, help desk, networking in practice), each with modules, practice and labs.
The browser-tab icon and header logo now match your theme.
Course overview cards follow the tab order (Learn, Labs, Practice, Exam), and the card you last used is highlighted.
The Discussion section is now a clear button with a comment count and a hint.
Learning paths have search and topic filters (AI, Cloud, Security and more).
Fuller explanations with verified documentation links for Google ACE and PCA, CompTIA A+ Core 1 and 2, Data+ and Tech+.
Fuller explanations with verified Microsoft Learn, AWS and man-page links for AZ-104, AZ-900, SC-900, DP-900, AI-901, AI-103, AWS Cloud Practitioner, Linux Essentials, Linux+ and RHCSA.
A course overview page for each course; Recents cards open it.
Study guides redesigned with numbered sections, steps, command tables and notes.
The question navigator's Domain filter is clearer.
AI-102 has been retired and replaced by AI-103; the old address redirects.
Labs: hands-on CLI, configuration and admin-console simulations, starting with A+ Core 1 and 2, Security+ and AZ-104.
Linux courses: LPI Linux Essentials, CompTIA Linux+ and Red Hat RHCSA, with a Linux lab simulator (RHEL administration, storage, SELinux, firewalld).
Learning paths for the beginner AI courses.
Narrated slides: each slide is read aloud with a short pause between slides.
Recents cards redesigned with compact progress stats.
The site is now called The IT Study Hall, with a new logo, the Monokai Pro look and a light/dark switch.
Medical courses: AAPC CPC, NHA CBCS and NHA CMAA.
Learn and Practice buttons on course cards, and a Browse learning paths page.
Guest mode (a limited preview) and feature requests for signed-in users.
